title: Who are you in mall world?
content: Curious for the experiencers here: For those of you who have a “sense of yourself” in mallworld, are you the same person as you are in waking life? I’ve been “going places” in dream state for over 40 years. I am not always a Caucasian middle aged female as I am in real life. Many of my experiences have been in the bodies of men, women and children of varying ages. Just curious if anyone else experiences this?
